intro: EventHub, LLC ("EventHub," "we," "us," or "our") operates an online marketplace connecting event rental and service vendors with customers. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform at eventhubglobal.com and any associated mobile or desktop applications (collectively, the "Platform").
By accessing or using the Platform you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please discontinue use.

blocks.text: **Information You Provide Directly**

items: **Account registration:** name, email address, and profile photo when you create an account.
**Vendor onboarding:** business name, business address, tax identification information, and bank or debit card details (collected and stored by Stripe — see Section 3).
**Listings:** photos, descriptions, pricing, availability, and location information you submit for your rental or service offerings.
**Bookings and payments:** event dates, delivery addresses, booking details, and payment card information (collected by Stripe — see Section 3).
**Messages:** content of messages exchanged between customers and vendors through our in-app chat.
**Reviews:** ratings and written reviews you submit for completed bookings.
**Support communications:** information you provide when contacting us.

blocks.text: **Information Collected Automatically**

items: **Usage data:** pages visited, search queries, listings viewed, clicks, and session duration.
**Device information:** IP address, browser type, operating system, and device identifiers.
**Location data:** approximate location inferred from IP address, and precise location (if permitted) used to show nearby vendors and to geocode addresses.
**Cookies and similar technologies:** session identifiers, analytics preferences, and feature-flag values stored in your browser. See Section 9 for details.

blocks.text: **Information From Third Parties**

items: **Auth0:** authentication information including your name, email, and profile image if you sign in with a social provider (Google, etc.).
**Stripe:** payment status, dispute notifications, and payout confirmation events delivered via webhook.
**Google Calendar:** calendar event data if you connect your Google Calendar to manage vendor availability.

blocks.text: We use the information we collect to:

items: Create and maintain your account and authenticate your identity.
Process bookings, payments, refunds, and payouts.
Connect customers with vendors and facilitate communication between them.
Send transactional emails (booking confirmations, payment receipts, dispute notifications, review prompts).
Enforce our Terms of Service, including our off-platform circumvention policy.
Detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents.
Improve and personalize the Platform through analytics and A/B testing.
Comply with applicable laws and respond to lawful requests from government authorities.

blocks.text: We do not sell your personal information to third parties, and we do not use it to serve behavioral advertising on behalf of third-party advertisers.

All payment processing on EventHub is handled by **Stripe, Inc.** ("Stripe"). When you enter payment card details, those details are transmitted directly to Stripe and are never stored on EventHub's servers.

Stripe is a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment processor. By completing a purchase or connecting as a vendor, you agree to Stripe's Privacy Policy (https://stripe.com/privacy) and the Stripe Connected Account Agreement (https://stripe.com/legal/connect-account).

EventHub receives from Stripe: payment status (succeeded, failed, refunded), payout confirmation, and dispute/chargeback notifications. We store these events to maintain accurate booking and financial records.

Vendor payouts are held for a platform-defined period following each event before being transferred to the vendor's connected Stripe account. Stripe's data practices, including data retention for financial records, are governed by Stripe's Privacy Policy.
Account authentication is managed by **Auth0, Inc.** ("Auth0"). When you register or log in, your credentials are processed by Auth0 under their Privacy Policy (https://auth0.com/privacy).
EventHub receives from Auth0: your user identifier, email address, name, and profile photo (if provided). We do not receive or store your password.
If you sign in using a social provider (such as Google), that provider's privacy policy also applies to information shared during authentication.

Vendor location and map display features are powered by **Mapbox, Inc.** When you browse vendors or enter an address, location data may be transmitted to Mapbox for geocoding and map tile rendering, subject to Mapbox's Privacy Policy (https://www.mapbox.com/legal/privacy).

Precise device location (GPS) is only accessed if you explicitly grant permission through your browser. You may browse the Platform without granting location access; we use your IP-derived approximate location as a default.

In-app messaging between customers and vendors is powered by **Stream, Inc.** Message content is transmitted to and stored by Stream, subject to their Privacy Policy (https://getstream.io/legal/privacy-policy/).

EventHub monitors message content to enforce our Terms of Service, including detection of off-platform solicitation. Messages flagged by our automated system may be reviewed by EventHub staff. If a vendor requests an AI-suggested reply, recent messages from that conversation are also processed as described in Section 8.
EventHub offers vendors an optional integration with Google Calendar to synchronize confirmed bookings into the vendor's calendar.
**What We Access**
When a vendor connects their Google account, EventHub requests three permissions:

items: **Read and write access to calendar events** (calendar.events) — used to create, update, and delete booking events in the vendor's selected calendar, and to register push notification watch channels so that changes made directly in Google Calendar are reflected in EventHub availability.
**Read-only access to the vendor's calendar list** (calendar.calendarlist.readonly) — used to display the vendor's available calendars so they can select which one to sync with.
**Access to the vendor's Google account email address** (userinfo.email) — used to display the connected Google account in the vendor's dashboard settings.

blocks.text: EventHub only reads event data from the specific calendar the vendor explicitly selects. We do not access Drive, Contacts, Gmail, or any other Google data.
**How We Use It**

We use Google Calendar data exclusively to write and update booking events when booking status changes, write vacation block events when a vendor marks dates unavailable, and receive push notifications when a vendor edits an event directly in Google Calendar so EventHub availability stays in sync. Google Calendar data is never used for advertising, analytics, or user profiling. EventHub's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy (https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.
**How We Store It**

OAuth access tokens (short-lived, ~1 hour) and refresh tokens (long-lived) are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM with a 256-bit key stored separately from the database. Tokens are never shared with any third party and are never logged or exposed to client-side code.
**Retention**

Tokens are kept while the integration is active. Disconnecting from the vendor dashboard immediately deletes all tokens from our database and revokes the access token with Google. Account deletion purges all Google tokens within 30 days.
**Vendor Rights**

Vendors may disconnect the Google Calendar integration at any time from dashboard Settings. This stops all future sync and deletes stored tokens. Previously created calendar events are not removed from Google Calendar on disconnect. Vendors may also revoke EventHub's access directly at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions

Some Platform features use large language models provided by **Anthropic, PBC** ("Anthropic"), the maker of Claude. These features run only when a vendor actively uses them — nothing is processed in the background.

**AI listing drafts.** When a vendor uses the "Fill with AI" option while creating a listing, the photos they upload and the listing details they have entered are transmitted to Anthropic to generate a draft title, description, and other listing fields. The vendor reviews and can edit everything before publishing.

**AI reply suggestions.** When a vendor requests a suggested reply in their chat inbox, the most recent messages in that conversation (currently up to 12) and the vendor's own FAQ document are transmitted to Anthropic to generate draft replies. Drafts are never sent automatically — the vendor decides whether to edit, send, or discard them. Because conversations include customer messages, a customer's recent messages in that conversation are processed when the vendor requests a suggestion.

Data sent to Anthropic is processed to provide these features, subject to Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service (https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms). EventHub does not use this data for advertising or profiling.

We use cookies and browser storage to operate the Platform, remember your preferences, and understand how the Platform is used. These technologies are how the usage and device information described in Section 1 is actually collected.

Product analytics are provided by **PostHog, Inc.** PostHog stores a pseudonymous visitor identifier in a cookie and in browser local storage, and records the pages you visit and product events such as creating an account or publishing a listing. PostHog creates a profile for anonymous visitors as well as signed-in users, and records the advertising campaign parameters contained in the link you arrived from. This is subject to PostHog's Privacy Policy (https://posthog.com/privacy).
The technologies we use fall into these categories:

items: **Strictly necessary:** authentication tokens stored in your browser's local storage by Auth0 to keep you signed in between visits. You cannot sign in or complete a booking without these.
**Preferences:** a first-party cookie that remembers whether the navigation panel is expanded, and browser storage that remembers your selected language.

**Analytics and experiments:** PostHog storage, described above. PostHog also determines which variant of a feature or pricing experiment your visit is assigned to and stores that assignment, so that the terms you were shown remain consistent rather than changing between visits.

**Attribution:** session storage recording which landing page and advertisement brought you to the Platform, so we can measure which campaigns are effective. This is cleared when you close your browser.

blocks.text: We do not use cookies or similar technologies for third-party advertising, and we do not allow third parties to use them on the Platform to build advertising profiles about you. We do not sell the information they collect.

Most browsers let you block or delete cookies and clear site storage through their settings. Blocking strictly necessary storage will prevent you from signing in or booking. Blocking analytics storage does not affect your ability to use the Platform.
We share your information only in the following circumstances:

items: **Between customers and vendors:** When a booking is created, we share the customer's name, event details, and delivery address with the vendor. The vendor's business name, location, and contact information are shared with the customer.

**Service providers:** We share data with Stripe, Auth0, Mapbox, Stream, PostHog, Anthropic, and other sub-processors as described above, and with cloud infrastructure providers (such as Railway, Neon, and Amazon Web Services, which stores uploaded photos and files), solely to operate and improve the Platform.

**Legal obligations:** We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or government authority, or if we believe disclosure is necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of EventHub, our users, or the public.

**Business transfers:** If EventHub is acquired, merged, or undergoes a similar corporate transaction, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you via email and/or a prominent notice on the Platform before your information is transferred.

blocks.text: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for their marketing purposes.

We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. We also retain information to comply with legal obligations (including tax and financial record-keeping requirements, which may extend up to 7 years), resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.
When you request deletion of your account, we will delete or anonymize your personal information within 30 days, except where retention is required by law or needed to resolve outstanding disputes.

We implement industry-standard safeguards including encrypted data transmission (HTTPS/TLS), encrypted storage of sensitive credentials, server-side authentication token validation, and access controls limiting staff access to personal data.

No method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we use commercially reasonable means to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security. If you become aware of a security vulnerability, please contact us at support@eventhubglobal.com.
Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

items: **Access:** request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
**Correction:** request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
**Deletion:** request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal retention requirements.
**Portability:** receive your personal information in a structured, machine-readable format.
**Objection:** object to processing of your personal information for certain purposes.
**Withdrawal of consent:** where processing is based on consent, withdraw it at any time without affecting prior processing.

blocks.text: To exercise these rights, email us at support@eventhubglobal.com. We will respond within 30 days. We may ask you to verify your identity before fulfilling a request.
If you are a California resident, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) provide you additional rights, including:

items: The right to know what personal information we collect, use, disclose, and sell.
The right to delete personal information we have collected from you (subject to exceptions).
The right to correct inaccurate personal information.
The right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information. **We do not sell or share personal information as defined under the CCPA/CPRA.**
The right to non-discrimination for exercising your privacy rights.

blocks.text: To submit a California privacy rights request, email support@eventhubglobal.com with "California Privacy Request" in the subject line. We will respond within 45 days.

The Platform is intended for users who are at least 18 years old. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under 13 without verifiable parental consent, we will delete that information. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at support@eventhubglobal.com.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you by updating the effective date at the top of this policy and, where required by law, by sending an email to the address associated with your account or by displaying a prominent notice on the Platform.
Your continued use of the Platform after the effective date of any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.
If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

items: **Email:** support@eventhubglobal.com
**Mailing address:** EventHub, LLC · Attn: Privacy · 1555 N Freedom Blvd · Provo, UT 84604 · USA

blocks.text: For disputes not resolved through our support team, you may have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

blocks.text: EventHub operates an online marketplace connecting event rental and service vendors ("Vendors") with customers seeking event-related goods and services ("Customers"). Together, Vendors and Customers are referred to as "Users."
EventHub expressly:

items: Is **not** a party to any transaction, booking, or agreement formed between Users
Does **not** own, operate, or control any listed goods or services
Does **not** guarantee the quality, safety, legality, or accuracy of any listing
Acts solely as a technology platform facilitating connections and processing payments as a limited payment collection agent

blocks.text: By accessing, registering for, or using EventHub, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms. You must be at least 18 years of age and legally capable of entering into a binding contract.

EventHub's liability to any User is capped at **$100** in the aggregate for any and all claims arising from use of the Platform. All disputes are subject to binding arbitration; class action claims are waived.

All Vendors are independent contractors — not employees, agents, or representatives of EventHub. EventHub is not vicariously liable for the acts, omissions, negligence, or misconduct of any Vendor or Customer.
Before any listing goes live, Vendors must complete a separate acceptance step in the vendor dashboard. By activating a vendor account, Vendors agree to the following obligations:

items: Provide accurate, complete, and non-misleading listing information
Fulfill all confirmed bookings exactly as described
Maintain compliance with all applicable laws, permits, licenses, and regulations
Carry appropriate business insurance where required by law or reasonably prudent
Respond to booking inquiries and customer communications in a timely manner
Remit applicable taxes on all revenue received through the Platform
Immediately notify EventHub of any material changes to their business or ability to fulfill bookings

blocks.text: Vendors may not solicit off-platform bookings, payments, or communications from Customers they meet through EventHub. Violations are subject to account suspension or permanent ban under the Anti-Circumvention Policy in Section 5.

**Customer service fee.** EventHub charges Customers a service fee of **5%** of the booked amount on every booking, on every plan and under every pricing model. It is added to the Customer's total and disclosed before checkout. Travel, delivery, and other vendor-charged fees collected through the Platform are part of the booked amount and carry the same 5% service fee.

**Vendor commission.** EventHub charges Vendors a platform commission of **8%** of the booked amount on every booking, deducted from the Vendor's payout. Two exemptions apply, and only these two: (a) a Vendor on the subscription pricing model who holds an **active paid EventHub Pro subscription** pays a 0% commission for as long as that subscription remains active; and (b) a **legacy Vendor**, as defined below, pays a 0% commission permanently. Vendors on the free tier of the subscription pricing model pay the 8% commission. Vendors on the commission pricing model have no subscription and no paid tier available to them, and pay the 8% commission on all bookings. No other status, program, or promotion waives the vendor commission, and the customer service fee is never waived by a Pro subscription or by legacy status.

**Legacy Vendors.** Vendors whose accounts were created before the vendor commission took effect were onboarded on the understanding that EventHub charged them no commission. EventHub honours that: those accounts are designated **legacy** and are permanently exempt from the vendor commission, at no cost and with no subscription required. This exemption is account-specific, is not transferable, and applies to the vendor commission only — **the 5% customer service fee still applies to bookings made with a legacy Vendor**, because that fee is charged to the Customer rather than deducted from the Vendor. EventHub reserves the right to designate individual accounts as legacy or otherwise fee-exempt, and different Vendors may therefore be charged different commission rates.

Fee rates are fixed at the time each booking is created and are not changed retroactively. All applicable fees are disclosed before checkout and in the vendor dashboard. Payments are processed by our third-party payment processor (Stripe). **Stripe's standard payment-processing fees are borne by the Vendor** and are deducted from the Vendor's payout; they are separate from, and additional to, any EventHub commission. Payout schedules and the applicable fees are disclosed in the vendor dashboard. Payouts are processed after successful booking completion, less any applicable fees. EventHub may change its fees, fee structure, and subscription pricing at any time; any change applies only to bookings and subscription periods that begin after it takes effect, and current fees are always shown before checkout and in the vendor dashboard.
All listings on EventHub are created and maintained exclusively by Vendors. EventHub does not verify, inspect, or endorse any listing, vendor, or the goods and services described therein.

**Cancellation policies are set by each Vendor, per listing, and are not standardized by EventHub.** Before proceeding to checkout, Customers are presented with that Vendor's specific cancellation policy and damage deposit terms. By continuing to checkout after reviewing these terms, Customers acknowledge and accept those vendor-specific policies. The dispute window described in Section 4 is separate from, and does not extend, any Vendor's cancellation policy.

Listing photos, descriptions, and pricing are provided by Vendors and may not reflect current availability or condition. Customers are encouraged to communicate directly with Vendors through the EventHub messaging system to confirm details before booking.
A binding booking is formed when a Customer completes checkout and payment is confirmed. By confirming a booking, Customers agree to:

items: Authorize the full payment amount charged through EventHub's payment processor
Accept responsibility for any damage to or loss of rented items beyond normal wear
Assume all risk of personal injury arising from use of the rented goods or services
Conduct all booking-related communications exclusively through the EventHub platform

blocks.text: Customers have a **72-hour window from the event date** to file a refund dispute. Disputes filed after this window will not be considered. Disputes must include supporting documentation.

EventHub processes payments as a limited payment collection agent on behalf of Vendors. Vendor payouts are released after the event date, subject to any open disputes. All payments are processed through Stripe and subject to Stripe's terms of service.
EventHub provides a messaging system to facilitate communication between Customers and Vendors. All booking-related communications must occur through this system.
Users are prohibited from sharing through the messaging system:

items: Email addresses or phone numbers
External website URLs or booking links
Social media handles or payment app usernames
Any information intended to facilitate off-platform transactions

blocks.text: EventHub's circumvention detection system monitors messages for prohibited contact information. q1.q: My event business is so custom — does EventHub have flexibility for customization?
q1.a: Yes. Build listings your way: single items, multi-tier packages, and add-ons customers can attach — each with your own pricing, what's included, deposit, and cancellation policy. Turn on pre-booking contact and customers can message you to work out the details before they book.

q2.q: Do I have to allow "instant bookings" from customers?
q2.a: No. Every listing has a booking type you control: Instant Book, or Request to Book — where customers submit their dates and you personally accept or decline. Outside of Rentals, listings default to Request to Book, so nothing lands on your calendar without your say-so.

q3.q: My business is logistics-heavy. How does EventHub handle logistics?
q3.a: Set your service radius and offer delivery, pickup, setup, takedown, and travel — each with its own fee. Fees can be flat or vary by location, and for out-of-area or variable jobs you send the customer a custom quote to accept before the booking is final.
